_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score-anchored Denial with weak institutional confirmation favors coiling one rung up at most rather than a forced directional break.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst HOLD but illegal Disbelief target; narrative silent on forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d increases above 97 and retail_noise_velocity rises above 20
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows drop below 0 and vix spikes above 25
